description: This file defines API route handlers for 'posts' in a social media backend. It sets up various endpoints for creating, deleting, retrieving, and interacting with posts, including commenting, liking, and searching. The routes are documented with Swagger annotations and include middleware for authentication and request validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new post with validation and authentication.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Handles deletion of a post by ID with authentication.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a post by ID, accessible without authentication.

methods.name: listByUser
methods.description: Lists posts by a specific username, with optional limit query parameter.

methods.name: feed
methods.description: Fetches the authenticated user's feed posts with optional limit.

methods.name: explore
methods.description: Retrieves public posts for exploration, with optional limit.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches posts based on query string and optional limit.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Adds a comment to a specific post, with validation and authentication.

methods.name: like
methods.description: Applies a like to a post, idempotent operation, requires authentication.

methods.name: unlike
methods.description: Removes a like from a post, idempotent, requires authentication.
